column1: # cost_models.tsv -- NBCONFIRM S2 (slot 25, 2026-11-07): the console cost estimators of the capped verbs, fitted on the reference box
# (RTX PRO 6000 workstation, 32 hw threads, CPU route) by docs/console/tools/nbconfirm_fit.py from docs/console/nbconfirm/s2_measurements.tsv;
# report docs/console/NBCONFIRM_S2_calibration.md.  ADVISORY ONLY: read by the S3 estimator (CostEstimate), never a value, a record or a hash
# input; the campaign driver and --bench ignore it.  A re-fit that changes any `term` row bumps the model id (`<verb>_<quantity>/v<k>`).
#   term   model_id verb variant regime threads j coef monomial     -- y = sum_j coef_j * prod x^e  ("1" = constant); wall in s, rss in MiB
#   resid  model_id verb variant regime threads n rms_log max_log max_log_ge1s   -- ln(measured/predicted) over the n fitted cells
#   grid   model_id verb variant regime threads feature lo hi       -- the fitted box: a feature above hi flags the estimate `extrapolated`
#   gmax   model_id verb variant regime threads max_measured        -- the group's largest measured value: the cost-space part est / gmax of x
#   lowconf model_id verb variant regime threads reason             -- a thin group (dof < 2, or a per-prime term on < 2 paired cells)
#   safety quantity band_floor x_exp strong_x                        -- q_hi = q * max(band, band_floor) * x^x_exp; strong warning at x > strong_x
#   fitted_on commit build_id sha256_prefix note                     -- the code the measurements were taken on (one model = one code)
#   thread verb rule                                                 -- how threads other than the fitted ones are handled (S2 Sec. 3.3)
#   calib  calib/v2 class slot threads ref_seconds digest rss_mib    -- the reference box's speed-probe times and peak RSS (S2 Sec. 4;
#          calib/v2 = NBCONFIRM S3, emitted by `cohomology_app --calibrate=thorough --emit-reference`; calib/v1 had no rss_mib)
#   class  verb kernel_class                                         -- the device-factor class that scales the verb's wall estimate
# variant: `full` / `anemic` (hecke_structure), `-` otherwise.  regime (descent / hecke_structure): N1 = (N = 1), n0 = (n = 0, N > 1),
# gen = (N > 1, n > 0); `all` otherwise.  threads: 1 / 16 = fitted at ENGINE_THREADS = that; `*` = thread-independent (pooled).
# Features: psi = [SL2(Z):Gamma_0(N)], n1 = n + 1, D = psi*n1, p2 = sum p^2, pr = psi*sqrt(p2) (P = the verb's primes, defaults applied),
#   np = |P|, sp = sum P, pm = max P, k, ell, W, m.
